policy.completion_rule_11_8: zero open/in_progress product defects with severity blocker or critical

issues.title: Physical playtest exposes a functional shell instead of a compelling authored game experience
evidence: First real-device human playtest screenshots show a mostly flat beige interface without the final illustrated gamebook presentation promised by the art direction.
Mata do Fio Verde event text and choices read as slot-composed fragments rather than a coherent scene with characters, causality, stakes and narrative payoff.
Brazilian Portuguese runtime visibly leaks internal/English labels including 'Hazard' and 'Resultado: defeat'.
The accessibility surface is visually weak in context, with low-contrast-looking text and a modal presentation that does not meet the intended polished gamebook experience.
The end-of-journey screen reports counters and an untranslated result token instead of delivering a narrative conclusion or emotional payoff.

The shared content/localization generators use fixed category leads and templated choice verbs across thousands of event units, allowing structural and coverage gates to pass without proving semantic or dramatic quality.
Final art for domains/locations, characters/NPCs and enemies/bosses remains pending under 7.3-7.5, and the 38 final audio references remain pending under 7.8/11.7.
issues.impact: Current Android builds are useful as technical harnesses but must not be treated as a release candidate or representative game build. Release work and the 11.3 physical soak are stop-shipped until a genuinely authored and audiovisually representative vertical slice is accepted in human playtest.
exit_criteria: Mata do Fio Verde vertical slice contains a coherent authored arc from opening hook through at least one named character encounter, exploration decision, gameplay conflict, consequence/callback and narrative ending.
Player-facing choices express distinct intentions and consequences instead of mechanically recombining nouns from the scene text.
Brazilian Portuguese vertical slice contains zero internal taxonomy labels or untranslated runtime tokens such as Hazard/defeat.

Representative final-style domain/location art, character/NPC art, enemy art, UI ornamentation, music/ambience and UI/combat SFX are integrated in the vertical slice in accordance with the approved art direction.
A human playtest on a physical Android device judges the vertical slice coherent, legible, visually alive, understandable and curiosity-generating, with no blocker/critical experience defect.
Only after that acceptance may full-scale content production and the 11.3 physical soak resume on a new candidate build.

issues.title: Compact launch localization packs were not physically certified on the canonical branch
evidence: Current English multipart pack is contiguous part_000 through part_009 and totals 133572 Base64 characters; part_005 is 16000 bytes on the canonical branch.
Launch scope was explicitly narrowed to pt_BR and en; es_419 remains preserved as a deferred locale and is no longer a release gate.
Pack compiler and certifier now derive non-source targets from localization/manifest.json, preventing deferred locales from remaining accidental launch blockers.
issues.resolution: The stale English segment defect was repaired, and the product launch contract now explicitly requires Brazilian Portuguese plus English only. Spanish work is retained for a future localization expansion rather than treated as incomplete launch content.
issues.impact: No active blocker remains from compact-pack physical persistence for the current two-language launch. 11.6 still requires its separate linguistic, terminology, overflow, iconography and same-HEAD regression gates before promotion.
exit_criteria: English compact pack remains contiguous and totals the certified 133572-character payload.
localization_pack_certification.py targets only locales declared by localization/manifest.json and requires en=18804/18804 with pack=15334.
Deferred es_419 is not exposed as a launch locale until its own future certification is complete.

issues.title: Purchase verification correlation could cross purchase and restore contexts for the same token
evidence: The prior coordinator keyed pending backend verification only by purchase_token and treated an already-pending token as satisfying a new verification request.

A purchase verification pending for token T could therefore make a concurrent restore of T appear to have no restore-context verification pending, allowing an authoritative snapshot to complete prematurely.
A delayed response from a retired restore generation could also match a new restore of the same token because the response had no independent request correlation identifier.

PlayBillingCoordinator now assigns a unique verification_request_id per request, stores pending work by that id, requires the backend to echo it exactly, and retires prior restore-generation request ids without reusing them.
PlayBillingCorrelationCertification reproduces overlapping purchase/restore and stale-response scenarios and requires request_correlation=1, overlap_safe=1 and stale_response_isolation=1.
issues.resolution: Backend verification correlation was separated from purchase-token deduplication. purchase_token remains the server-side idempotency key, while verification_request_id is now the client request/response correlation key. Purchase and restore requests for the same token can coexist safely, and stale restore responses cannot satisfy a later generation.
issues.impact: The known destructive/premature restore race has been removed in implementation and covered by an adversarial certification. 12.4 remains in progress until the Godot tests execute and the real plugin/backend/Play track integration is certified.
exit_criteria: Every verifier request includes a non-empty unique verification_request_id and every accepted response echoes the exact id.
Overlapping purchase and restore for the same purchase_token retain separate pending verification requests.
A stale response from a retired restore generation cannot consume or complete the current restore request.
The 12.4 workflow runs both coordinator and correlation certifications on the same candidate HEAD before release certification.

non_defect_release_dependencies.description: Physical-device 1800-second thermal/battery/performance soak remains required, but is suspended until EXP-001 is resolved and a new representative candidate exists.
38 final audio references and perceptual audiovisual QA remain production dependencies, not product defects.
Final large illustrations for domains/locations, characters/NPCs and enemies/bosses remain production dependencies.
